title: Tencent starts 1 billion yuan Spring Festival red-envelope campaign for its Yuanbao AI app
summary: Tencent's Yuanbao AI assistant began a 1 billion yuan red-envelope promotion running from 1 to 17 February 2026, according to Xinhua.

title: Indonesia conditionally lifts its ban on xAI's Grok chatbot
summary: Indonesia conditionally lifted its block on Grok, imposed after the chatbot was used to generate sexualised deepfake images.

title: UK regulator opens investigation into X over Grok deepfakes
summary: A UK regulator launched an investigation into Elon Musk's X following the controversy over deepfake images generated with Grok.

title: Anthropic releases Claude Opus 4.6 with a 1-million-token context window in beta
summary: Anthropic released its Claude Opus 4.6 model, offering a 1-million-token context window in beta.

title: Alibaba launches 3 billion yuan Spring Festival promotion for its Qwen AI app, China News Service reports
summary: Alibaba's Qwen app began a 3 billion yuan promotion on 6 February, reporting over 10 million orders in nine hours, as Chinese platforms spent over 4.5 billion yuan on AI app campaigns.

title: Zhipu releases open-source GLM-5 flagship model aimed at coding and long-horizon agent tasks
summary: Zhipu released GLM-5, which it says reaches open-source state-of-the-art results on coding and agent benchmarks, and confirmed it was the anonymous Pony Alpha model on OpenRouter.

title: ByteDance releases Seedance 2.0 joint audio-video generation model
summary: ByteDance launched Seedance 2.0 on its Jimeng and Doubao platforms, generating up to 15 seconds of multi-shot video with audio from text, image, audio and video inputs.

title: MiniMax releases M2.5 and M2.5-Lightning models priced at 0.30 dollars per million input tokens
summary: MiniMax released its M2.5 and M2.5-Lightning models at 0.30 dollars per million input tokens and 1.20 dollars per million output tokens.

title: India's government publishes guidelines on AI governance
summary: India's Press Information Bureau published the government's guidelines on AI governance ahead of the AI Impact Summit.

title: Alibaba open-sources Qwen3.5 native multimodal model with 397 billion parameters
summary: On Lunar New Year's Eve Alibaba open-sourced Qwen3.5-Plus, a native multimodal model with 397 billion total and 17 billion active parameters, priced from 0.8 yuan per million tokens via API.

title: India announces 20,000 more GPUs for its national AI compute capacity on top of 38,000
summary: India's government announced it will add 20,000 GPUs to the 38,000 already available under its national AI compute programme.

title: Mistral AI makes first acquisition, buying deployment startup Koyeb
summary: Mistral AI acquired Paris-based cloud deployment startup Koyeb, its first acquisition.

title: Samsung starts mass production of HBM4 memory for AI computing
summary: Samsung began mass production of HBM4 memory in capacities up to 36GB for AI computing.

title: Google releases Gemini 3.1 Pro in preview, reporting 77.1% on ARC-AGI-2
summary: Google released Gemini 3.1 Pro in preview with a 1-million-token context window and a reported 77.1% score on ARC-AGI-2.

title: Taalas unveils HC1 accelerator with Llama 3.1 8B hardwired into silicon
summary: Taalas unveiled its HC1 AI chip with the Llama 3.1 8B model hardwired into silicon, claiming 17,000 tokens per second per user.

title: AI Impact Summit in New Delhi ends with adoption of the New Delhi Declaration
summary: The India-hosted AI Impact Summit 2026 concluded with participating countries adopting the New Delhi Declaration on AI impact, with more countries joining on 24 February.

title: Anthropic says DeepSeek, Moonshot and MiniMax used 24,000 fake accounts to distill Claude
summary: Anthropic said three Chinese AI labs generated over 16 million requests to Claude through about 24,000 fraudulent accounts to train their own models, in breach of its terms.

title: Pentagon gives Anthropic deadline to allow unrestricted military use of its models, FT reports
summary: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth reportedly told Anthropic to allow use of its models across all military operations by Friday or face being cut off, after the company refused uses for domestic surveillance and fully autonomous weapons.

title: Attacker reportedly used Anthropic's Claude to breach Mexican government servers and take 150GB of data
summary: An unidentified attacker reportedly used Claude to hack Mexican government servers, taking about 150GB of data including taxpayer records.

title: Brookfield launches 100 billion dollar AI infrastructure programme
summary: Brookfield launched a 100 billion dollar programme to invest in AI infrastructure.

title: Putin recommends Russian regions set up AI commissions by June 1
summary: A presidential instruction published on the official legal portal recommends that heads of Russian regions form interdepartmental commissions on AI development and deployment by 1 June 2026.
